purpose: Referencias visuales canónicas para la UI de camcraft. El review compara renders reales de la UI contra estos PNGs. Estas referencias NO se sobreescriben automáticamente.
how_to_run: Capturar la escena al tamaño de referencia y comparar contra fixtures/ui/<id>.png (sway headless/grim o harness webview cuando esté cableado).
update_policy: Las referencias en fixtures/ui son read-only para el tooling. Si una referencia cambia intencionalmente, reemplazá el PNG a mano y revisá el diff antes de commitear.

covers: Top bar (mark, product, document, search placeholder, layout/theme/settings actions)
Canvas-dominant dark layout and border hierarchy
roadmap_gaps: E6.1 Board layer identity: UI still draws generic layers; artboard shows role-specific board entries.
E6.2 Project tree: no board→layers→operations tree in cam-ui; browser content differs from artboard structure.
E6.3 Operation forms: no PCB operation forms in cam-ui; inspector content differs from artboard drill form.
E6.4 Tool panel bound to PCB operations: partial.
E6.6 Integrated preview+simulation: partial, not PCB-specific.
Settings pages beyond wired controls may show placeholders by design until their backing state exists.
